# WU (Wirtschaftsuniversität Wien)

> > Vienna University of Economics and Business (WU Wien) - Austria's leading business university offering comprehensive education, research, and student services through integrated digital platforms.

WU Wien is Austria's premier economics and business university, featuring departments like Bildungswissenschaft (Education Science), research initiatives on inequality and higher education, and centralized digital infrastructure including LPIS, myWU, and Office365 authentication for students and staff.

## Key Topics

- Wirtschaftsuniversität Wien (WU)
- LPIS (Learning Platform and Information System)
- Abteilung für Bildungswissenschaft
- Vienna University of Economics and Business
- Office365 authentication
- Business communication research
- Higher education (Hochschulbildung)
- Internationalization
- Diversity and inclusion
- ABC Regional Conference Vienna
- Student access portals
- WU history and 125th anniversary
- PURE research system
- European higher education
- Educational inequality research

## Core University Portals & Access

- [WU Homepage](https://www.wu.ac.at): Main homepage for Vienna University of Economics and Business (WU)
- [Central Authentication Portal](http://short.wu.ac.at/): Central authentication portal for myWU, LPIS, and VI student services
- [LPIS Portal](https://lpis.wu.ac.at/): LPIS portal login selection with Office365 authentication for WU access
- [Electronic Course Catalog](http://vvz.wu.ac.at/): Electronic course catalog and search interface for Wirtschaftsuniversität

## Education Science Department (Bildungswissenschaft)

- [Research at Education Science Department](https://www.wu.ac.at/abteilung-fuer-bildungswissenschaft/forschung): Education science department research on inequality and higher education
- [Master's Thesis Guidelines](https://www.wu.ac.at/abteilung-fuer-bildungswissenschaft/studium-lehre/masterarbeiten): Master's thesis guidelines and requirements for education science students
- [Research Partners](https://www.wu.ac.at/abteilung-fuer-bildungswissenschaft/forschung/unsere-kooperationspartnerinnen): International research partners of WU's education science department
- [Lisa-Maria Lukasser](https://www.wu.ac.at/abteilung-fuer-bildungswissenschaft/ueber-uns/unser-team/lisa-maria-lukasser): Staff profile of doctoral researcher Lisa-Maria Lukasser at WU Wien
- [Sophie Lehner](https://www.wu.ac.at/abteilung-fuer-bildungswissenschaft/ueber-uns/unser-team/sophie-lehner): Staff profile of university assistant Sophie Lehner at education dept

## Academic Conferences & Research Events

- [ABC Conference Call for Papers](https://www.wu.ac.at/2020abcvienna/call-for-papers): Call for papers for ABC Regional Conference on business communication
- [Conference Panels Overview](https://www.wu.ac.at/2020abcvienna/panels): Conference panel topics on webcare, virtual teams, and lingua franca
- [Panel 2: Digital Media & Workplace Communication](https://www.wu.ac.at/2020abcvienna/panels/panel-2): Panel 2 on digital media and workplace communication research
- [Panel 3: Virtual Global Teams](https://www.wu.ac.at/2020abcvienna/panels/panel-3): Panel 3 on virtual global teams and intercultural competence teaching
- [Conference Venue & Vienna Guide](https://www.wu.ac.at/2020abcvienna/venue/the-city): Vienna city guide and venue information for ABC conference attendees
